sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Irfan Ahmad Malik Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddhartha Varma,J.
Hon'ble Ram Manohar Narayan Mishra,J.

This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 8.8.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 236 of 2024, under Sections 376-D, 147, 323, 504, 506 of Indian Penal Code, Police Station Khutahan, District - Jaunpur, and a direction to the respondent authorities not to arrest the petitioner in pursuance of the impugned first information report.
Submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that the petitioner has been falsely implicated.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. submits that a cognizable offence has been made out and, therefore, no interference is warranted in the impugned first information report.
Instruction as has been placed by learned AGA, has been perused the Court.

The statement recorded of the victim under section 164 Cr.P.C., if is looked into a crime is definitely made out in which the petitioner has been implicated and prima facie commission of cognizable offence is revealed.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
